result.instructions: Tools for Repricer.com, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Request a new inventory report for my Amazon channel and tell me when it is ready."; "Download my latest inventory report and list the products that are priced at their minimum."; "Schedule the inventory report to run every 8 hours.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Repricer.com data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run repricer_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run repricer_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run repricer_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. repricer_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: repricer_list_report_requests
tools.title: List report requests
tools.description: List report requests with their status (ReportRequestId, report type, processing status). Use it to find the ReportRequestId of a report that you requested. Repricer API: GET /reports/requests.

reportRequestIdList.description: Comma-separated ReportRequestId values to filter by.

reportTypeList.description: Comma-separated report types to filter by, for example INVENTORY or TOP_SELLING.

reportProcessingStatusList.description: Comma-separated processing statuses to filter by, for example __SUBMITTED__.

maxCount.description: Maximum rows to return (1 to 100, default 10).

tools.name: repricer_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List the generated reports that are ready to download, with their ReportId and availability date. Use a ReportId with repricer_download_report. Repricer API: GET /reports.

reportRequestIdList.description: Comma-separated ReportRequestId values to filter by.

reportTypeList.description: Comma-separated report types to filter by, for example INVENTORY or TOP_SELLING.

maxCount.description: Maximum rows to return (1 to 100, default 10).

tools.name: repricer_download_report
tools.title: Download a report
tools.description: Download a generated report as CSV text by its ReportId (from repricer_list_reports). Long files are cut by the server, and the reply says so. Repricer API: GET /reports/download/{id}.

reportId.description: The ReportId of a generated report.

tools.name: repricer_get_repricer_file
tools.title: Get the repricer file
tools.description: Export the account's repricer file as CSV: the All Available Fields Amazon template with every listing. The call has a 2-minute timeout and is not suitable above 25,000 SKUs; use a report for large accounts. Long files are cut by the server, and the reply says so. Repricer API: GET /repricers.

tools.name: repricer_submit_report_request
tools.title: Submit a report request
tools.description: Ask Repricer to generate a report (for example __INVENTORY__). It returns a ReportRequestId. Repricer starts the next report only after the previous one completes. Check progress with repricer_list_report_requests. Repricer API: POST /reports/requests.

reportType.description: Report type, for example __INVENTORY__ (the docs show both __INVENTORY__ and INVENTORY; use the one your account accepts).

channelName.description: Channel name set in Repricer. Applies to INVENTORY and PRICING_LITE reports.

startDate.description: Start date for the report, if the report type uses one.

endDate.description: End date for the report, if the report type uses one.

reportOptions.description: Extra report options, as the parameter list defines them.

tools.name: repricer_schedule_report
tools.title: Schedule a report
tools.description: Create or change a report schedule, so Repricer regenerates the report on that period (each new run overwrites the last report). Use schedule NEVER to remove the schedule. Schedule values: 30_MINUTES, 1_HOUR, 2_HOURS, 4_HOURS, 8_HOURS, 12_HOURS, 1_DAY, 2_DAYS, 3_DAYS, 7_DAYS, 14_DAYS, 15_DAYS, 30_DAYS, NEVER. Repricer API: POST /reports/schedule.

reportType.description: Report type, for example INVENTORY or TOP_SELLING.

channelName.description: Channel name set in Repricer. Applies to INVENTORY and PRICING_LITE reports.

schedule.description: How often to generate the report, for example 1_HOUR, or NEVER to remove the schedule.

tools.name: repricer_upload_repricer_file
tools.title: Upload a repricer file
tools.description: Import a CSV file into the Repricer account. The import changes repricing settings (minimum and maximum prices, rules) of the listings in the file, and so can change live prices on the marketplace. Only the All Available Fields Amazon template is supported. A second import fails until the first one finishes. Pass confirm true only after the user approved this exact file. Repricer API: POST /repricers.

csv.description: The complete CSV file content, with the header row of the All Available Fields template.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only when the user asked for this import.
